requirements.hashing: SHA-256 standard vectors and canonical artifact digest
requirements.serialization: authority-1 CJ-1 exact UTF-8 bytes, rejection rules and roundtrip
requirements.sqlite: BEGIN IMMEDIATE, rollback, immutable controller artifact/journal persistence and process restart
requirements.subprocess: selected sys.executable, argv with spaces, UTF-8 pipes, exit status and timeout
requirements.filesystem: Unicode/space paths, exclusive create, atomic replace, resolve/is_relative_to and scoped containment
requirements.audit: CPython audit hook denies outside-root file and network access through existing containment worker
requirements.execution: existing deterministic compiler/application and controller tests; no provider calls or protected inputs

version_policy: Version is a prerequisite only; every selected runtime must execute the pinned behavioral qualification. No upper bound justified; future versions are not presumed compatible.
